input.title: [iOS] Command Center remains open when selected Thought is moved as Subthought
input.body:
```
- A
- B
- C
```

## Step to Reproduce
1. Place the cursor on Thought C
2. Tap and hold to select or swipe up to open Command Center
3. While Command Center is onscreen, drag and drop Thought C as Subthought under Thought B


## Current behavior
Command Center is still onscreen but selection indicator is off.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/63918182-6f5f-4249-a2f2-30779c228708


## Expected behavior
Command Center should be closed.
Refer to Android behavior

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/76dae7d9-9fd4-4c3f-ae08-029d92cd9c71
